items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I got a letter from Frank Walker which I brought, asking me to work for Columbia... I loved Mr. Walker. He was a prince.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Wait a minute. I made records for Paramount, I made records in my baby sister's name, Josephine Beatty was her name, and I used her name, and in the meantime I got a letter from Frank Walker which I brought,

asking me to work for Columbia, see? And I couldn't work for Columbia, because I was contracted with Paramount. And he asked me in this letter how long was my contract going with Paramount, because, you know, he said Paramount is a small label and Columbia is a big label, so you know, enticing me to come over. I loved Mr. Walker. He was a prince. He was fine.
